review_title: Wrong-level and wrong-site spine surgery: mechanisms, the imaging step that fails, and decision support - a scoping review

reason_codes.E_NOT_SPINE: The record does not concern the spine at all (no spine, vertebral or spinal-region term).
reason_codes.E_NON_SPINE_WRONG_SITE: Wrong-site surgery outside the spine (wrong-site language with no spine term).
reason_codes.E_ANIMAL_CADAVER: Animal or cadaver-only work with no clinical claim.
reason_codes.E_EDITORIAL_NO_DATA: Editorial, comment, letter, erratum or news item with no data.
reason_codes.E_NO_FULLTEXT: No retrievable abstract or full text in the held corpus.
reason_codes.E_NO_CONCEPT: Spine record with no wrong-level, level-determination, enumeration or transitional-anatomy claim.
reason_codes.E_TECHNICAL_NO_LEVEL_CLAIM: Purely technical imaging paper with no level-determination claim.
reason_codes.E_NO_POPULATION: No human patient, clinical or imaging-of-enumeration population.
reason_codes.E_PROCEEDINGS_COLLECTION: A conference proceedings container (a block of abstracts), not a chartable record.

note: Records with no retrieved text are counted in the full-text box rather than at the automated screen, so that the flow separates 'not judged' from 'judged and excluded'.
